title: Chrono Trigger - Missables & One-Shot Items
summary: Everything that can be permanently lost in a single playthrough, ordered by when you can first get it.

items.label: Power Tab - Guardia Forest
items.note: Hidden in the bushes in the lower clearing. Not lost, just easy to skip.

items.label: Buy Cat Food for Crono's cat
items.note: Talk to the girl at the fair and take the cat home. Affects the trial and one of the endings.

items.label: Open all sealed chests AFTER examining them in 600 AD
items.note: Examine in 600 AD, open in 1000 AD (upgraded item), then reopen in 600 AD for the base item.

items.label: Toma's Pop (Choras Inn)
items.note: Pour it on Toma's grave at West Cape in 1000 AD to learn the Rainbow Shell location.

items.label: Magic Tab - Magus's Castle
items.note: Behind one of the fake-save-point rooms. The castle is not revisitable until New Game+.

sections.title: Side quests (after the Black Omen appears)

items.label: Save Lucca's mother (L-A-R-A on the machine)
items.note: During the Fiona's Forest flashback. Unlocks the Green Dream accessory.

items.label: Sun Stone
items.note: Moon Stone from Sun Palace (2300 AD) -> Sun Keep (65,000,000 BC) -> wait -> Sun Keep (2300 AD). Talk to the Porre mayor with the Jerky first.

items.label: Rainbow Shell: Prism Dress OR 3x Prism Helm
items.note: One-time choice from Melchior. Pick the helms unless you are running all three girls.

items.label: Ozzie's Fort - Gloom Helm + Gloom Cape
items.note: Both are in chests inside the fort. The fort is gone after you finish it.
